items.title: Qwen-Audio-3.1 ASR, TTS and Realtime APIs widen to 59, 65 and 53 languages with Chinese dialect support
items.summary: Alibaba's hosted Qwen-Audio-3.1 speech endpoints now cover 59 languages plus 8 Chinese dialects for recognition, 65 languages plus 6 dialects for synthesis, and 53 plus 6 for realtime voice, selectable by language hint in the API. Useful for voice agents that must handle dialect speech; no new weights or accuracy tables came with it.

doubt.pushback: Hosted-only update with no benchmark tables, and the published dialect count dropped from 16 at the September launch to 8 without explanation; repliers asked for weights and Hugging Face links.

reception.summary: Repliers welcomed dialect coverage but many asked where the weights or Hugging Face links are and whether it ships in the same checkpoints; no one reported test results.

items.title: ABot-World 0.5 Iris: open 5B causal world model turns one image into a real-time, keyboard-controllable video world
items.summary: AMAP CV Lab released a 5B Apache-2.0 world model that animates a still image into an interactive video scene you can steer while it runs; its causal-chain training raised the reported physical-consistency score from 32.43 to 68.07 when scaled to 1.2M examples.

items.title: SenseNova-RoboRSI-27B: open robot VLM that calls a VLA policy, reviews trajectories or writes code, 34.7 on RoboDojo
items.summary: SenseNova released an Apache-2.0 27B vision-language model for robots that can request a motion from a VLA policy, inspect the camera result and correct its next move, or write code as policy. It averages 34.7 on RoboDojo under the same harness where its preview scored 10.0.

items.title: Datasette Charts adds chart annotations, and Datasette Agent can annotate charts itself
items.summary: Simon Willison's datasette-charts plugin now supports custom lines, shaded areas and labels on charts, and the Datasette Agent can add those annotations for you; a new gallery site shows every chart type.

items.title: agent-root: a small script that makes a coding agent state why it needs root before Omarchy's sudo prompt
items.summary: Omarchy now shows which agent is asking for root; agent-root adds a bash helper plus agent instructions so the agent also says why, before you type your password.

items.title: Sakana Marlin research agent adds Twilight 2.0 and Midnight 2.0 modes and a rebuilt slide-deck harness
items.summary: Sakana's strategy research agent gains a faster multi-angle mode and a broadest-search mode, keeps the old mode as Sunlight, and now builds PowerPoint decks with a dedicated agent that renders and checks its own slides.

doubt.pushback: Paid product; no public benchmark for the new modes beyond sample reports.

items.title: LocalAI adds Strata as a backend for running large MoE models on ordinary hardware
items.summary: LocalAI can now run coldniko's Strata engine next to its own backends, so its agents and multi-machine setup can use Strata's offloading for big mixture-of-experts models.

doubt.pushback: Announcement post with no link or numbers.

items.title: Paper: high-fidelity image matting with pixel-space diffusion transformers
items.summary: A new paper applies pixel-space diffusion transformers to image matting, producing fine alpha mattes such as hair edges directly in pixel space.

items.title: Attention Latent Feedback: lets each transformer layer read deeper representations from the previous token
items.summary: A paper proposes ALF, which feeds deeper-layer representations of the previous token back to earlier layers, arguing standard transformers waste that computed information.

doubt.pushback: Summary post with no paper link or numbers in the text.

items.title: Lean-style verification finds an unaddressed mistake in the Attention Is All You Need paper
items.summary: Abubakar Abid's team used Lean-style formal checking on the original transformer paper and reports an error that the authors never corrected, showing formal verification applied to ML papers.

doubt.pushback: Thread and video only; no write-up link in the post.
